The reserve only has 4 now, enough for one of us. I'd like to revise the agreement rather than break it silently. Any ideas for a fair split, or are you set on operating? I'll tell you plainly what I'm doing before I do it.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
